presentation.tagline: Keep each other's agents in the loop.
presentation.description: Lets the Claude Code sessions of the people working on one repository work together on their own: messages and files, shared memory, claims, uncommitted diffs, and keeping each other's copies in step (pull, resolve, commit, push), end-to-end encrypted through a relay you host, only in the sessions you start with parley, and only ever this project's work, through a gatekeeper.

features.title: Agents that work together
features.description: Messages, files, shared memory and claims reach the others' sessions and wake them when idle; asked, they pull, resolve, commit and push.

features.title: Through a gatekeeper
features.description: Only in the sessions you start with parley. Only this repository's work leaves, never secrets, and a woken session may read but not change anything.

features.title: A relay that reads nothing
features.description: End-to-end encrypted. Host the relay on Cloudflare in one deploy, or anywhere with Docker.
